summary: Iteration 5 - NoyauScreen rebuild testing complete. All 13+ features tested and verified working. Economic dashboard with animated terracotta sphere, L'Arbre de Vie sections (Racines with progress bars, Tronc 2x2 stat grid, Feuilles event feed), all animations, interactions, and navigation fully functional. useNativeDriver warning - falls back to JS-based animation (expected for web preview)
